definition: Individuals using the Internet, % of world population: World Bank WDI indicator IT.NET.USER.ZS, World aggregate (WLD), whose data are ITU's estimates (ITU Facts and Figures); obs = data year

Share of the Erdős problems listed in the erdosproblems database (github.com/teorth/erdosproblems, data/statistics_history.csv; the problems of erdosproblems.com) whose status is solved (proved, disproved or otherwise solved: column total_solved) out of all problems listed (total_problems), at the last database snapshot by the end of the obs month (UTC); the list itself grows

Fewest physical qubits sufficient to factor a 2048-bit RSA modulus according to the best published resource estimate (a paper or preprint with a full resource count) at a physical gate error of about 0.1% (10^-3); value = its stated qubit count ('less than N' records N); obs = the estimate's publication date

Physical qubits in the largest gate-based quantum computer whose median two-qubit gate error across the whole device is at most 0.1% (fidelity >= 99.9%), as reported by its builder for the full device (not a subset or a test chip); obs = the date that device's figures were first published. The error threshold matches the assumption of qday-rsa2048-qubits-needed

Neurons whose synapse-level wiring was reconstructed and proofread in the largest published connectome of one animal (a whole brain or nervous system, or a partial volume), by the publication's own neuron count (non-neuronal cells and neurons without reconstructed connectivity excluded); obs = the publication date (paper or dataset release)

Highest superconducting critical temperature at ambient pressure (Tc as the publication reports it, typically the resistive or magnetic onset) among materials whose superconductivity (zero resistance and Meissner effect) has been reported by at least two independent groups; metastable phases retained at ambient pressure count; obs = the date the record was established (the confirming report, not the first claim). Room temperature is about 293 K

HPL Rmax of the rank-1 system on the TOP500 list (top500.org, published each June and November), in PFlop/s; obs = the list month (YYYY-06 or YYYY-11). Only systems submitted to the list count (large private AI clusters are often absent)
Confirmed exoplanets in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (Planetary Systems Composite table, pscomppars) with discovery year <= obs year, counted in the archive at retrieval; obs = calendar year
